classification.difficultyReason: Requires introducing an unmarked perpendicular height, expressing it using sine and connecting it to triangle area. The numerical task supports the subsequent symbolic proof, but neither diagram supplies the construction.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area in square metres of the triangle shown below, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with horizontal 12 m base, 7 m left side and included lower-left angle 35 degrees.
spec.mathematics: Base 12 m; adjacent sloping side 7 m; included angle 35 degrees. No altitude is supplied.

answer.short:
$24.09\text{ m}^2$.

Use sine to find the perpendicular height, then halve the product of base and height.
answer.worked:
Let $h$ metres be the perpendicular height from the apex to the base.
$$\begin{align*}\sin35^{\circ}&=\frac{h}{7}\\h&=7\sin35^{\circ}\\A&=\frac12\times12\times h\\A&=\frac12\times12\times7\sin35^{\circ}\\A&=42\sin35^{\circ}\\A&\approx24.09\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Prove that the area of triangle $ABC$ is $\dfrac12 ab\sin\theta$.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle ABC with B above horizontal AC. No altitude or right-angle mark is supplied.
spec.mathematics: AB=c, BC=a, AC=b; interior angle ACB=theta.
spec.answerVisibility: All original labels remain visible; the proof construction is solution-only.

answer.short:
$h=a\sin\theta$, so $A=\dfrac12 bh=\dfrac12 ab\sin\theta$.

Drop a perpendicular from $B$ to $AC$ and use the sine ratio.
answer.worked:
Draw $BD\perp AC$, with $D$ on $AC$, and let $BD=h$.
In right-angled triangle $BCD$:
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{h}{a}\\h&=a\sin\theta\end{align*}$$
Using base $AC=b$ and perpendicular height $h$:
$$\begin{align*}\operatorname{Area}(ABC)&=\frac12 bh\\\operatorname{Area}(ABC)&=\frac12 b(a\sin\theta)\\\operatorname{Area}(ABC)&=\frac12 ab\sin\theta.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete original triangle with a dashed perpendicular altitude BD, height h and right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: BD is perpendicular to AC; sin(theta)=BD/BC=h/a.
spec.answerVisibility: Altitude, D, h and right-angle marker appear only in the solution.
